title: A Day at the Monastery

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly (labels can be read aloud)

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Here, every day has its rhythm: a time to pray, a time to work, a time to eat, a time to learn, and a time to rest.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: These cards show our day, but they've been shuffled. Can you put them in order, from morning to night?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put the cards in order: what comes first in the day?
steps.hint: What do we do as soon as the sun comes up?

feedback.out_of_order: Some cards came back. What comes first?
feedback.all_good: Wake, pray, work, eat, learn, sleep. A day with a good rhythm!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: A day with a rhythm is a peaceful day. Perhaps your days at home have a rhythm too?

journal_line: I put the cards of a monastery day in order with Brother Elias.
